description:
Analyze the TCP capture file '200722_tcp_anon.pcapng' (located in ~/Documents/captures/) to measure the initial Round-Trip Time (RTT) for all successful TCP handshakes.

1. Analyze the capture and extract the 'initial_rtt' for every completed handshake.
2. Create a CSV file at '~/Documents/captures/handshake_latencies.csv' with the header: src_ip, dst_ip, src_port, dst_port, initial_rtt_seconds.
   - Ensure values are in seconds (e.g., 0.0245).
   - Each connection should appear only once.
3. Create a summary text file at '~/Documents/captures/handshake_summary.txt' containing:
   - Total number of connections measured
   - Minimum RTT (in milliseconds)
   - Maximum RTT (in milliseconds)
   - Mean RTT (in milliseconds)
   - The details (Src IP, Dst IP, Dst Port) of the connection with the SLOWEST (highest) RTT.
